skill.summary: Automatically track tech company financial reports and generate investment summaries. Supports retrieving earnings calendars, market expectation comparisons,...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Financial Report Tracker.
- Automatically retrieves tech company earnings calendars.
- Compares market expectations (EPS, revenue) with actual results.
- Interprets earnings reports: highlights key metric changes and summarizes management guidance.
- Generates standardized investment summaries in Markdown format.
- Command-line interface supports tracking, previewing, and reviewing company earnings reports.
